notes: Asking price is in the highlight block with id 'hs_cos_wrapper_bedrooms' and label 'Asking Price'. Revenue (Gross Sales) is in the highlight block with id 'hs_cos_wrapper_acres' and label 'Gross Sales'. Cash Flow is in the highlight block with id 'hs_cos_wrapper_est_mortgage' and label 'Cash Flow'. These IDs are stable across all three pages. The city is never disclosed — only a state/region label (e.g. 'Minnesota') is shown in hs_cos_wrapper_city_state; no city is published on any page. State is reliably found in span#hs_cos_wrapper_city_state. Cash flow may be blank on some listings (e.g. the liquor store St Paul page) but the field itself exists on the site.
